svg.aria-label: The child's alleles: the mother's share at parent-opposite sites, and the share of the mother's own allele at her heterozygous sites
svg.text: Where the parents are opposite homozygotes: the child's maternal allele (short reads)
Where only the mother is heterozygous: the child's share of the allele only she has (HiFi reads)
